name: @activepieces/piece-just-invoice
description: Create and manage invoices with JustInvoice API

auth.description: Enter your JustInvoice API key. You can find this in your JustInvoice account settings.

create_invoice.name: create_invoice
create_invoice.description: Creates a new invoice in JustInvoice

customerProvinceState.description: Province or state of the customer

customerCountry.description: Country code of the customer (e.g., US, CA)

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new invoice in JustInvoice for a customer, with at least one line item, optionally setting it to Draft or Final status on creation. Use to bill a customer or generate an invoice record. Not idempotent: each call mints a new invoice even with identical input.

get_invoice.name: get_invoice
get_invoice.description: Gets detailed information about a specific invoice

invoiceId.description: The ID or invoice number of the invoice to retrieve

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves full details of a single JustInvoice invoice by its ID or invoice number. Use to look up an invoice before acting on it or to read its current status. Read-only and idempotent.

mark_invoice_final.name: mark_invoice_final
mark_invoice_final.description: Marks an invoice currently in draft as final and ready to accept payment

invoiceId.description: The ID or invoice number of the invoice to mark as final

aiMetadata.description: Transitions a draft JustInvoice invoice (by ID or invoice number) to final status so it can accept payment. Use after a draft invoice is ready to issue. Idempotent: an invoice already final stays final.

mark_invoice_cancelled.name: mark_invoice_cancelled
mark_invoice_cancelled.description: Marks an invoice currently in final as cancelled

invoiceId.description: The ID or invoice number of the invoice to mark as cancelled

aiMetadata.description: Transitions a final JustInvoice invoice (by ID or invoice number) to cancelled status. Use to void an issued invoice instead of deleting it. Idempotent: an invoice already cancelled stays cancelled.

mark_invoice_paid.name: mark_invoice_paid
mark_invoice_paid.description: Marks an existing final invoice as paid

invoiceId.description: The ID or invoice number of the invoice to mark as paid

aiMetadata.description: Marks a final JustInvoice invoice (by ID or invoice number) as paid. Use to record that payment for an issued invoice has been received. Idempotent: an invoice already marked paid stays paid.

invoiceId.description: The ID or invoice number of the invoice to delete

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes a JustInvoice invoice by its ID or invoice number. Use to remove an invoice entirely; prefer cancelling instead of deleting an issued invoice. Idempotent in effect: once removed, the invoice stays gone.
